title: GxP-Agent: Process-DAG Topology for Reliable Clinical Trial Programming with LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.16890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical trial programming -- transforming study protocols into analysis-ready datasets under CDISC standards -- is a bottleneck in regulatory submissions, yet LLM-based code generation fails catastrophically on this task: across 11 single-shot attempts with five frontier models, none produces a valid subject-level analysis dataset. We introduce GxP-Agent, a multi-agent system that encodes regulatory process ordering as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), decomposing monolithic dataset generation into 15 domain-specific nodes executed by worker agents with pharmaverse skill context, validation gates, and conditional retry. On CDISC-Bench, a new execution-based benchmark built from the FDA pilot submission CDISCPilot01 (254 subjects, 49 ground-truth ADSL variables), GxP-Agent with Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves 100% structural match (49/49 variables, 254 correct records) across three independent runs, compared to 59.2% for the best retrieval-augm

translated_title: GxP-Agent：基于过程DAG拓扑的LLM代理可靠临床试验编程
translated_abstract: 临床试验编程——将研究方案在CDISC标准下转换为分析就绪数据集——是监管提交中的瓶颈，然而基于LLM的代码生成在此任务上表现灾难性失败：在五次前沿模型的11次单次尝试中，没有一次能生成有效的受试者级别分析数据集。我们引入了GxP-Agent，一个多代理系统，将监管流程顺序编码为有向无环图（DAG），将整体数据集生成分解为15个领域特定节点，由具备pharmaverse技能上下文、验证门和条件重试的工作代理执行。在CDISC-Bench上，这是一个基于FDA试点提交CDISCPilot01（254名受试者，49个地面真实ADSL变量）构建的新执行基准，GxP-Agent配合Claude Sonnet 4.6在三次独立运行中实现了100%的结构匹配（49/49个变量，254条正确记录），而最佳检索增强方法的匹配率仅为59.2%。
tldr: 本文提出GxP-Agent，通过将监管流程编码为DAG并分解为15个专业节点，实现了临床试验编程中100%的数据集生成准确性，显著优于现有LLM方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GxP-Agent, which encodes regulatory processes as a DAG and decomposes them into 15 specialized nodes, achieving 100% accuracy in clinical trial dataset generation, significantly outperforming existing LLM methods.
